lessons.sourceEnglishSkills: state a time limit, ask what can arrive quickly, and decide
lessons.sourceEnglishScenario: You have twenty minutes before museum entry; negotiate a realistic lunch plan.
lessons.title: Lunch before the museum
lessons.objective: State a twenty-minute time limit, ask what can be served quickly, compare wait times, and choose a lunch.
lessons.focus: 二十分しかありません states that only twenty minutes remain. 何分かかりますか asks how many minutes something takes. すぐに出せますか asks whether it can be served quickly; 先にお会計 can request paying first.
lessons.scene: Sam has twenty minutes before a museum entry time.

cards.ja: 食べる時間が二十分しかありません
cards.en: I only have twenty minutes to eat

cards.ja: 日替わり定食は何分かかりますか
cards.en: How many minutes does the daily set take?

cards.ja: サンドイッチをお願いします
先にお会計できますか

cards.en: Can it be served right away?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: すみません。食べる時間が二十分しかありません。
reader.en: Excuse me. I only have twenty minutes to eat.

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: 承知しました。何がよろしいですか。
reader.en: Understood. What would you like?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 何が早く出せますか。
reader.en: What can you serve quickly?

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: スープとサンドイッチは五分ほどです。
reader.en: The soup and sandwich take about five minutes.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 日替わり定食は何分かかりますか。
reader.en: How many minutes does the daily set take?

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: 十五分ほどです。
reader.en: About fifteen minutes.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: では、サンドイッチと小さいサラダをお願いします。
reader.en: Then a sandwich and a small salad, please.

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: かしこまりました。
reader.en: Certainly.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 先にお会計できますか。
reader.en: Can I pay first?

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: はい、こちらでどうぞ。
reader.en: Yes, please pay here.

speaking.opening: いらっしゃいませ。お急ぎですか。
speaking.goal: Say you only have twenty minutes, ask what can come out quickly and how long the set lunch takes, then choose a faster meal and ask to pay first.
speaking.closure: サンドイッチをお願いします。

lessons.sourceEnglishSkills: report cold food, a missing item, or a long delay respectfully
lessons.sourceEnglishScenario: One meal never arrived and the others are finished; ask for a fair solution.
lessons.title: Correcting a missing lunch order
lessons.objective: Report a forty-minute delay, a missing meal and drink, and cold soup respectfully, then ask for an order check and a fair bill correction.
lessons.focus: まだ来ていません says an ordered item has not arrived. 四十分待っています states the wait. 注文を確認してもらえますか asks staff to check the order. 料金から外してもらえますか requests removal from the bill.
lessons.scene: Sam’s friends have finished lunch, but Sam’s soup and one drink have not arrived.

cards.ja: 友達はもう食べ終わりました
cards.en: My friends have already finished eating
We have been waiting forty minutes

cards.ja: 私の料理がまだ来ていません
cards.en: My meal has not arrived yet

cards.ja: 注文を確認してもらえますか
飲み物が一つ足りません
この料理を料金から外してもらえますか
cards.en: Could you remove this dish from the bill?
What can you do to resolve this?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: すみません。私の料理がまだ来ていません。
reader.en: Excuse me. My meal has not arrived yet.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 四十分待っています。友達はもう食べ終わりました。
reader.en: We have waited forty minutes. My friends have already finished eating.

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: 申し訳ありません。注文を確認します。
reader.en: I am sorry. I will check the order.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: お願いします。飲み物も一つ足りません。
reader.en: Please do. One drink is missing too.

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: 厨房で確認しました。スープが遅れています。
reader.en: I checked with the kitchen. The soup is delayed.

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: 今、スープをお持ちしました。
reader.en: I have brought the soup now.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 届いたスープが冷たいです。
reader.en: The soup that arrived is cold.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: この料理を料金から外してもらえますか。
reader.en: Could you remove this dish from the bill?

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: はい。スープの料金を外し、飲み物をお持ちします。
reader.en: Yes. I will remove the soup charge and bring the drink.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: ありがとうございます。
reader.en: Thank you very much.

speaking.opening: お待たせしております。いかがなさいましたか。
speaking.goal: Say your meal has not arrived after forty minutes, mention the missing drink and cold soup, ask staff to check, and request a fair bill correction.
speaking.closure: 対応ありがとうございます。

lessons.sourceEnglishSkills: ask to split by person or item and handle cash and card
lessons.sourceEnglishScenario: Four travelers need two separate card payments and one cash payment.
lessons.title: Three payments for four diners
lessons.objective: Ask to split a four-person bill by person or item, arrange two card payments and one cash payment, and check the total and receipt.
lessons.focus: 別々に払えますか asks to pay separately. 人ごとに asks for a per-person split; 料理ごとに asks by item. カードで二件、現金で一件 specifies two card transactions and one cash transaction. 合計 means total.
lessons.scene: Four travelers arrange three payments after a shared lunch.

cards.ja: お会計をお願いします
料理ごとに分けられますか
cards.en: Can you split it by dish?

cards.ja: カードで二件、現金で一件お願いします
cards.en: Two card payments and one cash payment, please

cards.ja: サービス料は合計に含まれていますか
cards.en: Is the service charge included in the total?

cards.ja: 領収書をお願いします
カードでも払えますか
cards.en: Can we also pay by card?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 四人分のお会計をお願いします。
reader.en: The bill for four people, please.

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: はい、こちらです。
reader.en: Certainly, here it is.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 別々に払えますか。
reader.en: Can we pay separately?

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: はい。人ごとですか、料理ごとですか。
reader.en: Yes. By person or by dish?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 料理ごとに分けたいです。
reader.en: We would like to split it by dish.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 二人分は一枚のカードでまとめます。
reader.en: We will put two people’s meals on one card.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: カードで二件、現金で一件お願いします。
reader.en: Two card payments and one cash payment, please.

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: 分かりました。三回に分けます。
reader.en: Understood. I will split it into three transactions.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: サービス料は合計に含まれていますか。
reader.en: Is the service charge included in the total?

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: はい、含まれています。
reader.en: Yes, it is included.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.ja: 領収書をお願いします。
reader.en: A receipt, please.

reader.speaker: Staff
reader.ja: はい、どうぞ。
reader.en: Certainly, here you are.

speaking.opening: お会計ですね。まとめてお支払いですか。
speaking.goal: Ask to split a four-person bill by dish, explain that one card covers two people, make two card payments and one cash payment, check the service charge, and request a receipt.
speaking.closure: 領収書をお願いします。ありがとうございます。
